title: Hopi ant people as a global subterranean species
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hopi ant people as a global subterranean species, about ancient at Arizona, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Chilean researcher David Velasco speculates that this could be a global subterranean species. For example, the Hopi people, traditionally associated with Arizona, have a legend around the ant people.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on an idea from a Chilean researcher named David Velasco: that a race of beings might live underground all around the world. As an example, Michels points to the Hopi, a Native American people of Arizona, whose legends tell of the "ant people", who are said to live beneath the earth. If this were true, it would mean stories from very different cultures are describing the same hidden species.
